name: staff
description: Product-agnostic agent staff, packaged as Claude Code plugins. Install pinned release tags only (S-GEN-016).

plugins.name: staff-core
plugins.description: Shared rules and guardrails every staff agent loads.

plugins.name: staff-product
plugins.description: Business-analyst agents. Lean slice: the Analyst read stage at stage 1.

plugins.name: staff-engineering
plugins.description: Architect, developer and DevOps agents. Built at stage 1; not wired to any workflow yet.

plugins.name: staff-qa
plugins.description: Test engineer agents. Stage 1: test-gen-api (API-layer tests) only.

plugins.name: staff-review
plugins.description: Shared reviewer with one checklist skill per artifact type. The requirements checklist is wired (reviewer/requirements, stage 1).

plugins.name: staff-meta
plugins.description: Meta agents. First: the seeding agent for the Developer's eval sets.
